about_the_game:
Step into the exhilarating world of retail with VR Store Simulator! 🛒

Become the ultimate supermarket manager in a stunning VR environment .

  • 📦 Stock an array of products

  • 🤝 Satisfy your customers' needs

  • 🏪 Master the art of daily store operations

Watch your business flourish as you invest in upgrades and expand your store, offering even more to your ever-growing customer base.

With incredibly realistic interactions and exciting challenges, VR Store Simulator blends strategic management with immersive fun.

Are you ready to transform your humble shop into a bustling retail empire? Jump in and start your journey to success!

name: VR Store Simulator

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64 bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4590
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1070
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • VR Support: OpenXR or Oculus PC. Standing or Room Scale
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

short_description: 🌟 Step into a dynamic VR supermarket! 🛒 Manage your store, stock shelves, cater to customers, and create the ultimate shopping destination . Perfect for fun and learning, this immersive simulation lets you strategize and thrive in supermarket management. Ready to start?
supported_languages: English, French, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Korean, Japanese, Russian, Portuguese - Portugal
